summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of the Live Editor on /about. Admin login, Live Editor nav button, auto-open with ?edit=1, selection boxes, section toolbar, all control testids, add-section menu, duplicate, move, hide, section background color, undo/redo, save (PUT /api/admin/pages/about/live returns 200) and public persistence all verified functionally. Anonymous visitor safety confirmed (no editor UI with or without ?edit=1). CRITICAL functional defect found: text-style controls (font-family, font-size, font-weight, line-height, letter-spacing) are visually inert on headings/body because index.css lines 1210-1226 declare these properties with !important on `.site:has(main) main .h1/.h2/.h3/.eyebrow/.prose/.lede/...`, which overrides the inline styles the LiveEditor writes via sx(). Values are correctly saved in the backend (confirmed via network trace + inline style attr on element), but the computed style never changes, so the user sees no effect. Section background, padding, color (not in !important list), italic (font-style), uppercase (text-transform), text-align all DO visibly work and persist. UX defect: the fixed Live Editor top toolbar (undo/redo/save/exit) renders behind the sticky public header navigation (right-side nav links), causing Playwright `page.click(force=True)` to be intercepted and real users may struggle to click Save on the first attempt.

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor text controls vs global CSS
ui_bugs.issue: Inline typography styles set by live-font-select/live-font-size/live-font-weight/live-bold/live-line-height/live-letter-spacing are overridden by `!important` rules in /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 1210-1226 (`.site:has(main) main .h1 { font-size: var(--fs-h1) !important; ... }` etc). The payload saves correctly and the inline style attribute is present on the DOM node (e.g. style="font-size: 72px"), but computed font-size stays at the CSS clamp value. Result: changing font/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing has NO visible effect on headings or body text, defeating the primary purpose of the editor. Bold toggle (fontWeight 700) is also neutralized. Italic, uppercase, color, align, section background, section padding all work.
ui_bugs.selector: main .h1, main .h2, main .h3, main .prose, main .lede, main .eyebrow

ui_bugs.component: LivePanel top toolbar vs sticky header
ui_bugs.issue: The fixed `.live-panel` top row (undo/redo/save/exit buttons) overlaps the sticky site header on the right side. Playwright `page.click('[data-testid="live-save-btn"]', force=True)` was repeatedly intercepted by `<li>` / `<a data-testid="nav-m-connect">` from `.header`. Clicking the save button only worked via a direct DOM `.click()` call (bypassing pointer hit-testing). Real users will frequently miss-click save on the first try. Needs higher z-index on `.live-ui` than the public header OR hide the public header while `.live-editing` is on.

ui_bugs.component: Toaster not reachable from LiveEditor save path during test
ui_bugs.issue: `[data-sonner-toaster]` was not present in DOM when inspected inside the live-editor flow (though Toaster is mounted in App.js). Success toast after save was not observed in automation (even when the PUT returned 200). May be a mounting/portal issue specific to this page tree. Low-impact (functionality works) but UX feedback is missing on save success/failure in some runs.

integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/admin/pages/about/live returns 200 and payload persists on plain /about reload (verified: section background color #00ff00 round-tripped from editor to anonymous public view). Add Text section also persists (count 8->9). This part works correctly end-to-end.

issues: Live panel toolbar is visually hidden behind the sticky public header navigation (WHO WE ARE / OUR WORK / FIELD NOTES / CONNECT) in the top-right.
No visible success toast confirming save in some runs.

action_items: FIX (critical): Remove `!important` from typography declarations on `main .h1/.h2/.h3/.eyebrow/.prose/.lede/.aside-statement/...` in /app/frontend/src/index.css around lines 1210-1226 OR scope those rules so they only match when there is no inline style, OR have LiveEditor's sx() emit CSS custom properties / append `!important` to its inline styles when a user sets them. Without this fix, the live editor's font/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing controls are decorative only.

FIX (high): Raise z-index of `.live-ui` / `.live-panel` above the sticky public header (or hide/translate the header when `body.live-editing`). Currently the save/undo/redo/exit buttons are physically occluded by the header's right-side nav links, breaking the click.
FIX (medium): Confirm Sonner `<Toaster/>` is actually mounted/portaled when the Live Editor is active. Add explicit toast on save success/failure so the user has feedback.

CODE QUALITY: LiveEditor.jsx is ~360 lines of densely compacted single-line JSX with heavy use of inline arrow functions and anonymous handlers. It is functional but hard to review/maintain; consider splitting into <PanelHeader/>, <TextControls/>, <SectionStyle/>, <AddMenu/>, <SelectionBox/> and extracting the mouse-drag resize logic.

CODE QUALITY: In `commit`, `content.sections` is captured via closure for the hist.past snapshot; this is correct but subtle. Consider using the functional updater form of setContent to derive previous value more explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css lines 1210-1226 override live editor typography via !important — primary defect.
z-index conflict between .header (sticky) and .live-panel (fixed) — primary UX defect.
LiveEditor.jsx > 350 LOC in a single file with intermixed concerns; split recommended.
No visible error message/UI when save fails silently (reliant on toast).

`remount()` is called after many state updates (addSection, undo, redo, upload, inline text commit) — key-based remount of Blocks is fine but will blur the active contentEditable element on every keystroke commit; works but may interrupt the typing experience.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (12/15 flows pass visually; typography controls fail visually; toolbar occlusion)

seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily set a section background on /about then cleared and re-saved so /about is back to default.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright `page.click(force=True)` on `[data-testid="live-save-btn"]` is intercepted by the sticky header. Use `page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('[data-testid="live-save-btn"]').click())` as a workaround. To test font-size/font-family persistence after fixing the !important bug, read `getComputedStyle(el).fontSize` on `main [data-edit="heading"]`, not just the inline style attribute. Testids present and correct for everything in the spec. Anonymous visitor path verified safe. /about has been restored to clean state (no background colors).
rca_of_the_issue:
RCA (Typography controls not visibly changing): The LiveEditor writes per-field CSS via inline `style={{fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, ...}}` on the rendered element (see Blocks.jsx `sx()`). Inline styles normally win over any stylesheet. However /app/frontend/src/index.css contains a block (lines 1210-1226) that applies `!important` to `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-weight`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`, `margin-bottom` for `.site:has(main) main .h1/.h2/.h3/.eyebrow` and for `.site:has(main) main :is(.prose, .prose p, .lede, ...)`. CSS !important beats inline styles unless the inline style itself is marked !important. Therefore the inline attribute `style="font-size: 72px"` is present on the H1 element but computed font-size stays at `clamp(38px, 3.4vw, 52px) => 52px`. Verified via DOM inspection: `inlineStyle='font-size: 72px'`, `computedFontSize='52px'`. Reproduction: login as owner → open /about?edit=1 → click 'About USP India' heading → change `live-font-size` to 72 → heading does not resize visually, nor after save+reload. Mitigation: either (a) drop !important from the main typography rules, (b) scope them to `main .h1:not([style*="font-size"])` (brittle), or (c) have sx() append CSS `!important` priority to every property it writes (reliable but hacky). Preferred: refactor index.css lines 1210-1226 to use higher specificity instead of !important.

RCA (Save button intercepted): `.header` is `position: sticky` with its own stacking context. `.live-panel` is `position: fixed` with z-index below (or equal to) `.header`. Playwright's hit-test finds the header's nav `<li>` on top at the toolbar's coordinates. Fix: set `.live-ui`/`.live-panel` z-index above header, OR hide header while `body.live-editing`.
